rules.accepted_credit_types: Category I (formally organized, min. 20 h LCSW / 10 h LBSW-LMSW): accredited college courses in a behavioral health discipline (max 15 h per course), CSWE-accredited school programs, programs by government social service agencies, schools, licensed health facilities/hospitals, or sponsors certified/approved by CWLA, NASW, NABSW, FSAA, CSWA, ASWB or any state social work board. Category II (individual activities, max 10 h LCSW / 5 h LBSW-LMSW): ASWB item writing, publications/presentations, field instruction, board/association service, formal staffings, individual study (max 5 h)
rules.new_licensee_rule: Newly licensed individuals do not document CE on the first renewal after initial licensure (18VAC140-20-100 B).
rules.alternatives: Up to 2 hours may be met by unpaid social work services to low-income patients of a local health department or free clinic (3 hours service = 1 CE hour).
rules.audit_note: Keep original documentation 3 years after renewal; the Board may audit (18VAC140-20-106). Shortfalls lead to consent agreements/fines per guidance doc 140-4-2.

topics.who: Ethics, standards of practice of behavioral health professions, or Virginia social work law

rules.notes: Licenses renew every year by June 30. The regulation's 'prior to licensure renewal in even years' wording sits in the LBSW/LMSW sentence; it does not state the period for the LCSW 30 hours, so no cycle is given here.
rules.rule_quote: Licensed clinical social workers shall be required to have completed a minimum of 30 contact hours of continuing education.
